identity.identificationBasis: The photographer records the tree as Acer palmatum “Shindeshojo”, and the visible exhibition label repeats that name at the 2008 Tatton Park Flower Show.
identity.limitations: This is a separately labelled trained bonsai, not the Meise specimen shown in the spring images. The exhibition label is the identity basis, and bonsai form is not representative of ordinary garden habit.
identity.publicQualification: Source-identified from an exhibition label; not independently authenticated by the Japanese Maple Atlas. Shown only as a separate summer-expression specimen; bonsai form is not cultivar habit.
